name: opencomms
description: OpenComms links existing OpenCode, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex and Gemini CLI sessions into project-local multi-agent channels, and separately creates explicitly managed OpenCode or configured ACP sessions. Includes framed push/pull messaging, workflow records, loopback GUI, integration onboarding and a standalone CLI. Linked sessions remain user-owned; managed capabilities and live verification limits are explicit.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 "dist-test/test/unit/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:vendor: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist-test/test/live/managed-vendor.test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "dist-test/test/unit/**/*.test.js" dist-test/test/live/live.test.js dist-test/test/live/managed-vendor.test.js
